summary: Ran the report at every commit between v2.3.0 and v2.4.0. Commit 9a04783 is the first to give the 2.4.0 totals, and the commit before the first-parent run of other-totals commits gives the 2.3.0 totals. The regression is the UTC conversion added to parse_stamp in tally/dates.py, and v2.4.0rc1 is the earliest tag containing the commit.
